method: Manual agent interpretation followed by implementation; no Markdown parser, generic compiler, or proved categorical construction.

purpose.meaning: Admit declared local hosts and one optionally configured private host with compatible browser Origin; no authentication or reachability claim.

operations.operation: If value equals empty string, return null.
Construct new URL(value) without base; propagate native parse exception.
Require conjunction of all predicates; throw policy Error on failure.

errors.message: WORKBENCH_ALLOWED_ORIGIN must be one exact HTTPS ts.net origin

operations.operation: Evaluate privateOrigin(configuredOrigin), propagating error before reading any header.
Read headers.get('host') and select exact local mapping first.
Otherwise select configured URL origin iff URL exists and Host exactly equals URL host; otherwise return false without reading Origin.
Read headers.get('origin'); return true iff null, empty string, or exactly expected origin.

constraints.meaning: Only standard Headers.get semantics, exact comparisons, no additional normalization or forwarding headers.
Use URL port semantics and literal hostname suffix; no DNS, network membership or separate port policy.
Synchronous; no I/O, environment access, logging, persistent mutation, network, service operations or HTTP responses; only declared input domain.

types.name: Configuration
types.meaning: Declared optional private origin spelling, default empty.

types.name: ParsedPrivateOrigin
types.meaning: Parsed canonical exact HTTPS origin satisfying suffix and component predicates; configuration acceptance does not establish network reachability.

types.name: OptionalPrivateOrigin
types.meaning: No private host or validated configured private URL.

types.name: RequestHeaders
types.meaning: Standard request headers accessed through get.

types.name: HostValue
types.meaning: Exact Host get result, not parsed or normalized by this module.

types.name: ExpectedOrigin
types.meaning: Origin selected from exact local mapping or matching configured URL host.

types.name: OriginValue
types.meaning: Exact Origin get result; empty string and absence are compatible.

types.name: AdmissionDecision
types.meaning: Host and Origin compatibility only; not authentication or authorization.

types.name: ConfigurationError
types.meaning: Exceptional configuration failure, never converted to false.

composition.scope: Finite typed composition model with exceptional and early-return branches; identity and associativity are obligations, not a proof of categorical semantics.
objects: HostContext = {headers: Headers, privateURL: OptionalPrivateOrigin, host: string|null}

arrows.name: parse
arrows.operation: Empty returns null; otherwise construct URL without base and preserve original string.

arrows.name: validate
arrows.operation: Null passes through; pair must satisfy all C3 predicates, then yield URL.

arrows.name: configure
arrows.operation: Carry headers without reading them; apply validate after parse to configuredOrigin.

arrows.name: selectHost
arrows.operation: Exact local mapping first; then exact configured URL host; otherwise false.

arrows.name: readOrigin
arrows.operation: Read Origin via Headers.get after host selection succeeds.

arrows.name: compareOrigin
arrows.operation: True iff origin is null, empty, or exactly expected.

order.branchPropagation: Rejected terminates with false before readOrigin. Configuration exceptions terminate before header reads and propagate unchanged.

composition.identityObligation: For each object X, id_X preserves values, object identity and branch/error behavior; composing on either side must preserve declared observable behavior.
composition.associativityObligation: For arrows with matching types, lifted composition over success/early-return/error branches must satisfy (h after g) after f equivalent to h after (g after f), preserving left-to-right evaluation, exception propagation and skipped header reads.
composition.apiEquivalenceClaim: Generated privateOrigin implements validate after parse. Generated allowedRequest implements configure, readHost, selectHost, and selected-only readOrigin/compareOrigin with the same defaults, return types and exceptions. This is an intended behavioral equivalence on the declared domain, not a universal proof; sampled tests provide evidence.

assumptions.kind: implementation choice with no declared observable effect
assumptions.choice: Use internal sequential if statements for local host mapping and strict equality checks; public exports remain exactly the two requested functions.
No behavior is specified or added for values outside string configuration and standard Headers input domains.
